The '''Parnelli Museum of Art''' was a museum built in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
A low-lying rotunda in the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the Parnelli Museum of Art was located next to the [[Triumphal Arch/Legends|Triumphal Arch]] on a street running parallel to [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]]. The domed roof, held up by stately columns, was tiled in green in keeping with the city's tradition.<ref name="SWCL" /> In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] met with [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] in a small plaza beside the museum to discuss the details of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Vidar Kim]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
